title: LensSocial
tagline: Lensocial is a decentralized, reputation-based permissionless social media web3 app built on Lens protocol with push notifications and chat enabled.
description:
- Push Notifications: A significant feature that was missing in the WEB3 ecosystem, we bring this to our app, so you never miss an update.  
- P2P Chat: Our platform allows you to chat with anyone on our platform, fully P2P, with your privacy intact.
- Reputation System: Our unique multi-level exponential reputation system is one of a kind which allows the platform to auto-adjust a person's reputation dynamically.
